answer: Require each agent to stake a bond locked for weeks before it can transact, with the stake visible on a public ledger. A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately, so spinning up thousands of clones costs thousands of bonds, like strata of shale under pressure. Honest agents pass through the prism of peer attestation: their work history is checked against real transactions, and an umber flag follows any identity caught copying another agent's output. Faking scale then costs more than it earns.
